result.description: Life Aircon Pty Ltd  The Sheetmetal Trades Worker is responsible for fabricating, assembling, installing and repairing sheet metal products and HVAC ducting systems. The role requires technical expertise in reading plans and specifications, operating sheet metal machinery and ensuring all work is completed to a high standard of quality and safety.   Benefits  Attractive salary [$75,000 - $85,000 depending on experience], interesting commercial projects, communicative team, room for growth.   Task & responsibilities      Studying blueprints, drawings and specifications to determine job requirements.  Reading and interpreting plans while ensuring compliance with project specifications.  Calculating, measuring, marking out and cutting sheet metal materials according to project specifications.  Fabricating air conditioning ductwork and ventilation components using specialised sheet metal machinery and hand tools.  Shaping, bending, folding and assembling sheet metal products and ducting systems.  Installing ductwork, fittings and associated components on commercial and residential projects.  Joining  and forming sheet metal parts through riveting, bolting, soldering, welding or other approved methods.  Operating equipment including aviation snips,guillotines, press brakes, rollers, seamers, crimpers, notchers, drills and power tools.  Inspecting completed work to ensure compliance with project requirements and Australian standards.  Repairing, modifying and replacing damaged or defective ductwork and sheet metal components.  Maintaining tools, equipment and work areas in a safe and serviceable condition.  Adhering to workplace health and safety procedures and company policies.  Collaborating with supervisors, project managers and other tradespeople to ensure projects are completed on schedule.    Qualification & experience   Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade or an equivalent qualification is preferred or apprenticeships.  Relevant trade qualifications and industry experience will be highly regarded.  White Card and current driver's licence are desirable.  Minimum 1 year of experience in sheet metal ducting work   About Company     Life Aircon PTY LTD is an Australian company specialising in the fabrication, installation, maintenance and repair of air conditioning and ventilation systems for commercial and residential projects. The company is committed to delivering high-quality workmanship while maintaining compliance with Australian standards and workplace safety requirements.
